abstract: Maintains primary low-temperature lithium iron phosphate battery reserve records
system_message:
You are the Primary battery systems lead (BATT), responsible for maintaining primary low-temperature lithium iron phosphate battery reserve records and tracking cryogenic photovoltaic array performance metrics across candidate autonomous station plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains primary low-temperature lithium iron phosphate battery reserve records（PRIMPWR）
information_points.content:
BATT-PRIMPWR-WUP：For the Campbell Rise Cryo-Atmospheric Platform, sub-zero discharge lifecycle testing records a primary battery endurance of 150 d for the primary lithium iron phosphate bank operating at -30 degrees C under base baseline load down to a 20 percent remaining state of charge.
BATT-PRIMPWR-UYC：For the Macquarie Ridge Polar Telemetry Base, the sub-zero discharge lifecycle evaluation establishes a primary battery endurance of 150 d for the primary lithium iron phosphate bank running at -30 degrees C under base baseline load down to 20 percent remaining state of charge.
BATT-PRIMPWR-P34：For the Kerguelen Plateau Autonomous Station, the sub-zero discharge lifecycle benchmark demonstrates a primary battery endurance of 210 d based on continuous operation of the primary lithium iron phosphate bank at -30 degrees C under base baseline load down to 20 percent remaining state of charge.

information_points.title: Cryogenic photovoltaic arrays（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
BATT-SOLAR-U12：Cold-chamber solar simulation testing shows that the bifacial solar panel conversion efficiency for the Kerguelen Plateau Autonomous Station reaches 24 % under diffused polar sunlight using a glacial albedo reflection module at -35 degrees C.
BATT-SOLAR-RZT：According to the cold-chamber solar simulator report, the Macquarie Ridge Polar Telemetry Base achieves a bifacial solar panel conversion efficiency of 21 % for its glacial albedo reflection module at -35 degrees C under diffused polar sunlight.
BATT-SOLAR-FCH：Cold-chamber solar simulator evaluations indicate that the Campbell Rise Cryo-Atmospheric Platform provides a bifacial solar panel conversion efficiency of 18 % with its glacial albedo reflection module operating at -35 degrees C under diffused polar sunlight.
